caption:
You know what a lead costs to get.

Most owners never calculate what it costs to wait, or to let one go cold for good.

Three costs hit every lead:

1. Acquisition Cost - what you paid to earn the conversation
2. Delay Cost - what disappears every hour you don't respond
3. Abandonment Cost - what a lead you never touch again was worth

This week: pull your last 20 leads. Calculate cost per lead. Log response times. Count how many got zero follow-up. That third number hurts the most.
